method.full_body_sampling: 16 nearly equidistant baked Action frames per cycle, both Walk and Jog, front/side/three_quarter; each rendered400x500 and inspected in4x4 sheets
method.closeup_camera: side view, tracks LeftFoot fore/aft; floor line projected from z=0; does not establish horizontal material-point slip
method.render_engine: Blender Workbench, original evaluated editable rig and skin
method.limitations: This review inspects temporally ordered still poses. Real-time rhythm, Godot correction, terrain, all15 derived clips and media timing require the separate runtime/media reviews. Numerical forces are not inferred.

findings.subject: Walk landing
findings.detail: Heel-first approach and heel contact are visible before gradual lowering of forefoot. Foot does not appear to slap down in one rigid orientation.

findings.subject: Walk terminal support
findings.detail: Heel rises while distal forefoot/toe skin stays close to floor; toe-joint articulation is visible instead of the whole foot remaining flat. Rear leg leads into flexed-knee recovery.

findings.subject: Jog landing
findings.detail: At final4degree setup the forefoot lands with modest heel elevation, then heel settles. The8degree candidate tip-first portrayal was corrected before this review.

findings.subject: Jog terminal support
findings.detail: Heel rise, distal forefoot support, toe extension and subsequent foot release are readable. No observed foot mesh collapse or floor penetration in selected poses.

findings.subject: Trunk and shoulders
findings.detail: Pelvis shifts and rotates under a partly counterrotating rib cage; arm/leg alternation and rear elbow travel remain clear. The abdomen is not visually a single rigid block in inspected front/oblique phases.

findings.subject: Leg/arm shape
findings.detail: No obvious knee inversion, foot crossing, upper-arm flare, hand/trunk intersection or waist-hinge forward collapse in the selected3view samples.

measurement_method_update: Contact-cycle landing/duration uses complete evaluated lower-foot skin. Heel/forefoot/toes landmark-patch timings and conservative distal-support counts are separate; gaps around MTP joint do not truncate whole-foot support. This changes numerical support durations, not the inspected source poses or image observations.
